title: BEST NEW CREEPER FARM - Minecraft Bedrock 1.21 - MCPE/Xbox/PS4/Nintendo Switch/Windows10
description:
In this video, I will show you how to make the next generation of the Infinite V1 a new upgraded version of hyper light creeper farm which now is combined with an ultimate power path finding system using water reaching higher speed accuracy and fixing an issue that hyper light farms had *creepers being stuck sometimes* in Minecraft!

If you enjoyed this channel, it will focus on high-performance and simple farms that are beyond levels of bedrock, so be sure to turn on the notification to be notified!
detailedDescription:
🧱 Farm Performance : 2903 ~ 7,390 P/H It depends on the number of layers, number of platforms, sizes, and level of enchantment you are using for this farm! It can even reach 16,000, but it needs to be set as quad based creeper farm (mob density versions), which needs chunk aligning

🔨 Farm Mode : Fully Automatic

✨ Versions : 1.16 - 1.17 - 1.18 - 1.19 - 1.20 - 1.20.1 - 1.20.2 - 1.20.3 - 1.20.4 - 1.20.5 - 1.20.6 - 1.21 - 1.21.30 - 1.21.40 - 1.21.50 - 1.21.1 - 1.21.2 - 1.21.3 - 1.21.40 - 1.21.50 - 1.21.4 -1.21.5 - 1.21.50 -1.21.55 - 1.21.60 - 1.21.70 - 1.21.80 - 1.21.71 - 1.21.80
